name: Post-drawdown stablecoin-inflow contrarian long (4h, Tether-after-the-blood)
rationale: MECHANISM: the one leading effect that survives the literature — stablecoin net inflows to exchanges arrive AFTER large price downturns and predict POSITIVE subsequent returns (NY Fed mint-burn work). Opportunistic capital moves stables onto venues to buy the dip; minting has real T+0..2 settlement latency and re-entry is staggered, so the inflow burst LEADS the recovery bounce by a few 4h bars. CONDITIONAL on a prior selloff (unconditional inflow corr <0.3). Entry: stablecoin_net_flow_usd positive spike AND prior ret_Nd deeply negative. Other side = the capitulating holder who already sold. DISCONFIRMER: if removing the prior-selloff precondition (ret_Nd) does NOT degrade the edge, the flow feature is inert and the selloff filter does all the work. HARD KILL: if a same-sized long fired on RSI oversold ALONE matches or beats it net of fees, stablecoin_net_flow_usd adds nothing.
catalyst: stablecoin inflow spike arriving after a sharp 4h selloff
